title: tddworks/baguette
claim: tddworks/baguette — Headless iOS Simulator manager/farm + host-side input injection for iOS 26 — taps, swipes, multi-finger gestures, and 60
why_good: A headless iOS Simulator farm with host-side input injection — real infra pain for mobile CI and agent-driven iOS testing.
value: Sell to mobile teams and testing platforms as a simulator-farm/CI backend; usage + enterprise.
risk: Niche, Apple-toolchain-dependent, and Apple can change Simulator internals; small but real buyer set.
pick_reason: The project offers a specific tool for mobile developers that can be monetized through subscriptions or licenses.
